body.statement: The Ejaz--Bareinboim \(\rho\)-Markovian RSCM class has finite observed domains and uniformly bounded relational-parent multisets, permits within-instance latent confounding through shared exogenous parents, and is the domain of their complete relational identification procedure and neural identified-case criterion.

source.locator: Definition of rho-Markovian relational causal models; Theorem 5.2 and Corollary D.6

body.justification: The comparator qualification depends on the published model-class scope and completeness domain.
body.gap: This is cited substrate rather than a contribution of the present note.
body.consumer: The one-row theorem states exactly which conclusions transfer from the fully Markovian subclass to the larger comparator class.
